cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads, 1000% = 10 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (10240 MB = 10 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

port.desc: Port your app listens on (TCP). It is passed to ASP.NET Core in ASPNETCORE_URLS and to the app as the PORT environment variable

dotnetversion.desc: Version of the .NET SDK (mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk) that builds and runs the app

gitrepo.desc: HTTPS URL of a git repository to download on install, for example https://github.com/user/my-bot.git. Reinstalling pulls the latest commit. Leave empty to upload the files yourself

gitbranch.desc: Branch to check out. Empty means the default branch of the repository

gittoken.desc: Personal access token for a private repository (GitHub, GitLab). Leave empty for public repositories

project.desc: Project (.csproj) or folder to publish, relative to the server folder, for example src/MyApp/MyApp.csproj. Empty: the project or solution in the server folder

buildonstart.desc: Publish the project before every start, so code changes are picked up. Off: the build of the install (or of the last start) is run

startdll.desc: Run this .dll (an app you published yourself and uploaded) instead of building, relative to the server folder, for example publish/MyApp.dll

dotnetenv.desc: Value of DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT and ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: picks appsettings.<Environment>.json

commands: bash -c "for f in AetherPlaceholder.csproj Program.cs; do if grep -qs 'Placeholder written by Aether Panel' \"$f\"; then echo \"Removing the placeholder $f\"; rm -f \"$f\"; fi; done"

bash -c "set -e; if [ -z \"$GIT_REPO\" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ \"$(id -u)\" = 0 ] && command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"Installing git in the install container\"; apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates >/dev/null; else echo \"git is not installed, it is needed to download the repository\"; exit 1; fi; fi; g() { git -c safe.directory='*' -c init.defaultBranch=main -c advice.detachedHead=false \"$@\"; }; auth=(); if [ -n \"$GIT_TOKEN\" ]; then auth=(-c \"http.extraHeader=Authorization: Basic $(printf 'oauth2:%s' \"$GIT_TOKEN\" | base64 | tr -d '\\n')\"); fi; [ -d .git ] || g init -q; echo \"Fetching $GIT_REPO ${GIT_BRANCH:-(default branch)}\"; g \"${auth[@]}\" fetch -q --depth 1 \"$GIT_REPO\" \"${GIT_BRANCH:-HEAD}\"; g reset -q --hard FETCH_HEAD; echo \"Checked out $(g log -1 --format='%h %s')\""

install.text:
<!-- Placeholder written by Aether Panel. Replace it with your project, or set a git repository in the server settings and reinstall. -->
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <!-- the newest framework of the SDK that builds it, so it follows the .NET Version setting -->
    <TargetFramework>net$(NETCoreAppMaximumVersion)</TargetFramework>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
  </PropertyGroup>
</Project>

commands: bash -c "has=0; for f in *.csproj *.fsproj *.vbproj *.sln *.slnx; do if [ -e \"$f\" ]; then has=1; fi; done; if [ \"$has\" = 0 ] && [ -z \"${project}\" ]; then echo \"No .NET project yet: writing a placeholder AetherPlaceholder.csproj and Program.cs\"; cp .aether/placeholder/AetherPlaceholder.csproj .; if [ ! -e Program.cs ]; then cp .aether/placeholder/Program.cs .; fi; fi"

bash -c "set -e; export DOTNET_CLI_HOME=\"$PWD/.aether/dotnet\" NUGET_PACKAGES=\"$PWD/.aether/nuget/packages\" NUGET_HTTP_CACHE_PATH=\"$PWD/.aether/nuget/http-cache\"; own=0; for f in *.csproj *.fsproj *.vbproj *.sln *.slnx; do if [ -e \"$f\" ] && [ \"$f\" != AetherPlaceholder.csproj ]; then own=1; fi; done; if [ -n \"${project}\" ]; then own=1; fi; if [ \"$own\" = 1 ] && grep -qs 'Placeholder written by Aether Panel' AetherPlaceholder.csproj; then echo \"Removing the placeholder AetherPlaceholder.csproj: the server folder has its own project\"; rm -f AetherPlaceholder.csproj; if grep -qs 'Placeholder written by Aether Panel' Program.cs; then echo \"Removing the placeholder Program.cs\"; rm -f Program.cs; fi; fi; p=\"${project}\"; a=(); if [ -n \"$p\" ]; then a=(\"$p\"); fi; has=0; for f in *.csproj *.fsproj *.vbproj *.sln *.slnx; do if [ -e \"$f\" ]; then has=1; fi; done; if [ -z \"$p\" ] && [ \"$has\" = 0 ]; then echo \"Aether Panel: there is no .NET project in the server folder. Upload your project, or set a git repository and reinstall.\"; exit 0; fi; echo \"Publishing ${p:-the server folder}\"; rm -rf .aether/publish; dotnet publish \"${a[@]}\" -c Release -o .aether/publish --disable-build-servers"

run.command: bash -c "set -e; unset GIT_TOKEN ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS ASPNETCORE_HTTPS_PORTS; export DOTNET_CLI_HOME=\"$PWD/.aether/dotnet\" NUGET_PACKAGES=\"$PWD/.aether/nuget/packages\" NUGET_HTTP_CACHE_PATH=\"$PWD/.aether/nuget/http-cache\"; if [ -n \"${startdll}\" ]; then if [ ! -f \"${startdll}\" ]; then echo \"Aether Panel: ${startdll} not found. Upload it, or empty Start DLL to build the project.\"; exit 0; fi; echo \"Starting ${startdll}\"; exec dotnet \"${startdll}\"; fi; own=0; for f in *.csproj *.fsproj *.vbproj *.sln *.slnx; do if [ -e \"$f\" ] && [ \"$f\" != AetherPlaceholder.csproj ]; then own=1; fi; done; if [ -n \"${project}\" ]; then own=1; fi; if [ \"$own\" = 1 ] && grep -qs 'Placeholder written by Aether Panel' AetherPlaceholder.csproj; then echo \"Removing the placeholder AetherPlaceholder.csproj: the server folder has its own project\"; rm -f AetherPlaceholder.csproj; if grep -qs 'Placeholder written by Aether Panel' Program.cs; then echo \"Removing the placeholder Program.cs\"; rm -f Program.cs; fi; fi; p=\"${project}\"; a=(); if [ -n \"$p\" ]; then a=(\"$p\"); fi; has=0; for f in *.csproj *.fsproj *.vbproj *.sln *.slnx; do if [ -e \"$f\" ]; then has=1; fi; done; if [ -z \"$p\" ] && [ \"$has\" = 0 ]; then echo \"Aether Panel: there is no .NET project in the server folder. Upload your project, or set a git repository and reinstall.\"; exit 0; fi; if [ \"${buildonstart}\" = true ] || [ ! -d .aether/publish ]; then echo \"Publishing ${p:-the server folder}\"; rm -rf .aether/publish; dotnet publish \"${a[@]}\" -c Release -o .aether/publish --disable-build-servers; fi; dll=\"\"; c=(); for f in .aether/publish/*.runtimeconfig.json; do if [ -f \"$f\" ] && ! grep -qs -e Microsoft.TestPlatform -e Microsoft.Testing.Platform \"${f%.runtimeconfig.json}.deps.json\"; then c+=(\"${f%.runtimeconfig.json}.dll\"); fi; done; if [ ${#c[@]} = 1 ]; then dll=\"${c[0]}\"; else n=\"$(dotnet msbuild \"${a[@]}\" -getProperty:AssemblyName 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 | tr -d '\\r')\" || true; if [ -n \"$n\" ] && [ -f \".aether/publish/$n.dll\" ]; then dll=\".aether/publish/$n.dll\"; fi; fi; if [ ! -f \"$dll\" ]; then echo \"Aether Panel: cannot tell which .dll in .aether/publish is the app. Set Project to the .csproj of the app, or Start DLL to .aether/publish/<YourApp>.dll.\"; exit 1; fi; echo \"Starting $dll\"; exec dotnet \"$dll\""
